### Project Goals

1. **Roster Accessibility:** Provide accessible, filterable team rosters for all NAIA institutions with women's wrestling programs.
2. **National Tournament Results:** Track individual national tournament placements, points scored, and win-loss match records from official NAIA Championship events.
3. **Data Transparency:** Offer clean, public CSV datasets for sports data science research and analysis.

### Data Sources & Methodology

- **Tournament Data:** Sourced from official public event tournament results hosted on [Trackwrestling](https://www.trackwrestling.com).
- **Institutional Directory:** Compiled from NAIA varsity athletics directories, tracking institution names, locations, and conferences.
- **Built with:** [Quarto](https://quarto.org), [R](https://www.r-project.org/), and the [Tidyverse](https://www.tidyverse.org/).
